name: Sawaguchi Natsumi
source:
Turning up at the underwater city Atalancia with Haruki, a cheerful sporty girl and a member of the national swimming team, for her, who loves swimming more than eating three meals, living under the sea is like a fish that has found water. She is the protagonist's childhood friend, they are very close and can easily understand each other, but she is an overly caring person.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.lumpofsugar.co.jp/product/haruyome/images/character/character002.png]official website[/url]]
